results.title: Minister Oyedele: 30-day discount is not enough. How did you arrive at ₦1,350 ex-gantry ceiling price?
results.description: On October 8, 2026, Finance Minister Taiwo Oyedele announced a 30-day petrol discount at NNPC stations, prioritising public transport. He proposed a ₦1,350-per-litre ex-gantry or landing-cost ceiling, with suppliers temporarily absorbing excess costs for later recovery. The post Minister Oyedele: 30-day discount is not enough.
